programme.desc: Comment réussir à mesurer le temps ? Pour y parvenir, nos ancêtres observaient le mouvement des astres. Aujourd'hui, on utilise des horloges atomiques tellement précises que les astres prennent du retard ou de l'avance sur nos montres. Horloges d’hier et d’aujourd’hui, clepsydre, sablier, cadran solaire… Les sorciers nous emmènent à la découverte des machines à mesurer le temps.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de C'EST PAS SORCIER s'arrête à la centrale nucléaire de Cattenom en Moselle pour savoir ce que l'on fait de tous les déchets radioactifs. C'est à la Hague que l'on retrouve ensuite l'équipe de C'est Pas Sorcier : elle a eu l'autorisation exceptionnelle de tourner à l'intérieur de cette usine de retraitement des combustibles usés. Le périple s'achève enfin à Cadaraches, près d'Aix en Provence, où sont traités et entreposés tous les déchets nucléaires produits par le Commissariat à l'Energie Atomique. Quel volume de déchets nucléaires la France produit-elle ? Des simples gants ou chiffons contaminés jusqu'aux produits de fission, que fait-on de ces déchets ? Comment sont-ils triés en fonction de leur radioactivité et de leur durée de vie ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion se rend à la centrale nucléaire de Cattenom en Moselle. Exceptionnellement Fred a pu pénétrer dans le cœur de la centrale : le bâtiment réacteur ! Quand la centrale fonctionne, c'est ici qu'a lieu la fameuse "réaction nucléaire" qui produit de l'énergie sous forme de chaleur. Nous en découvrons le combustible - l'uranium, et la manière dont il est renouvelé. Nous suivons ensuite toutes les étapes qui conduisent à la production d'électricité.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le camion de "C'EST PAS SORCIER " prend la route des étoiles direction l'observatoire du Pic du Midi dans les Pyrénées pour un tour d'horizon de la voûte céleste. Depuis l'observatoire le plus haut de France, Fred se promène dans le ciel et fait la lumière sur tout ce qui brille au-dessus de nos têtes (étoiles, planètes, comètes...). L'oeil rivé sur un coronographe, il observe la couronne du soleil. Grâce à un télescope, il suit la planète Mars dans la constellation du Lion ou encore un ouragan sur la planète Jupiter.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous emmènent en Savoie pour comprendre à quoi servent les barrages et comment ils fonctionnent. Comment construit-on un barrage ? Comment l'eau y est-elle transformée en électricité ? Pourquoi les barrages se déforment-ils ? Quelles conséquences peuvent-ils avoir sur l'environnement ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans toutes les grandes métropoles, les gens habitent et travaillent dans d'immenses tours. Mais comment ces tours font-elles pour tenir debout, pour résister aux tempêtes ou aux séismes ? Et connaissez-vous la vie secrète d'une tour ? Le fonctionnement de ses ascenseurs, de ses gigantesques réseaux de ventilation, d'alimentation d'eau, d'électricité ? Le long d'un parcours insolite, nous voyageons dans les entrailles de ces cathédrales du 20ème siècle qui défient les lois de la nature.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: En accompagnant la Brigade des Sapeurs Pompiers de Paris dans l’une de ses nombreuses missions, les sorciers nous expliquent tout sur le feu et les manières de le combattre. Comment un incendie se déclare-t-il ? Pourquoi l’eau éteint-elle certains feux et pas d’autres ? Comment les pompiers se protègent-ils de la chaleur et des flammes ? Comment font-il pour avoir suffisamment de pression à l’intérieur de leurs tuyaux ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Savez-vous que vos ordures ne passent pas à la poubelle ? Elles sont triées et recyclées. Verres, boîtes de conserve, cartons, caoutchouc... ces matériaux retournent à la case départ pour fabriquer les objets les plus inattendus ou pour produire de l'énergie. Nous suivons les déchets à la trace, depuis le vide-ordures jusqu'aux usines de recyclage et d'incinération...

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Des centres de production aux lieux de consommation, C’est pas sorcier nous dévoile tous les secrets de l’électricité. Qu’est-ce que l’électricité ? Comment se déplace-t-elle ? Tension, intensité, puissance… qu’est-ce qui fait la différence ? Comment répare-t-on des lignes à haute tension sur lesquelles circule un courant de 400 000 volts ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Nous allons voler à bord des hélicoptères de l’Aviation Légère de l’Armée de Terre et nous irons chez Eurocopter, premier fabricant d’hélicoptères en Europe. Fred expérimente le pilote d’une Gazelle, petit hélicoptère très maniable. Il nous montre comment décoller, rester sur place, manoeuvrer... Nous assisterons à un vol tactique avec une patrouille de Gazelles ainsi qu’à un vol de nuit grâce aux jumelles de vision nocturne. Jamy nous expliquera comment faire voler un objet plus lourd que l’air, comment l’hélicoptère décolle et se dirige et pourquoi il ne peut pas aller au-delà de 400km/heure

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy nous font partager une partie de bataille navale à grande échelle. Ils nous font parcourir les entrailles d’une vraie île flottante : le porte-avions Foch. A bord, Fred nous fait parcourir tous les étages du Foch. Nous pénétrons dans la salle des machines, le hangar des avions de défense, parcourons le pont d’envol et tous ses dangers, visitons les dortoirs et même un bloc opératoire. Du camion, Jamy nous explique la production d’électricité à base de propulsion à vapeur ou à base de propulsion nucléaire, comment se fait le catapultage et l’appontage des avions ainsi que les risques causés par le tangage et le roulis

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Poulpes, calmars et seiches sont des céphalopodes. Leur point commun ? Ils ont les pieds sur la tête ! Fred, Jamy et Sabine dressent le portrait de ces étonnants mollusques marins. Pourquoi les poulpes avancent-ils à reculons ? Comment les seiches se servent-elles de leur fameux os pour flotter ? A quoi le drôle de bec des céphalopodes leur sert-il ? Pourquoi l’encre visqueuse que recrache la seiche en cas de danger permet-elle de tromper l’ennemi ? D’où viennent les extraordinaires capacités mimétiques des céphalopodes ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Sans pattes, comment les serpents font-ils pour avancer ? A quoi leur sert la langue fourchue qu'ils agitent tout le temps ? D'où vient leur venin ? Comment arrivent-ils à manger des proies beaucoup plus grosses qu'eux ? C'est vrai que les serpents sont sourds comme des pots ? Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous font découvrir l'univers de ces reptiles beaucoup plus sympathiques qu'on ne l'imagine. Entre cobras à lunettes, pythons constricteurs, bébés boas et couleuvres multicolores, ils nous présentent les locataires de l'île aux serpents, un parc zoologique proche de Poitiers. Nous les retrouvons dans la forêt de Chizé pour découvrir avec eux les onze espèces de serpents qui vivent en France et ce qu'il faut faire en cas de morsure.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L’île Longue, en face de Brest, abrite la plus secrète et la plus stratégique des bases de la marine nationale. C‘est d’ici que partent les 4 sous-marins français armés de missiles nucléaires. Leur mission : dissuader d’éventuels ennemis d’attaquer la France. Durant quelques jours, Fred a partagé la vie des 110 d’hommes d’équipage du « Téméraire ». Jamy, lui, a décidé d’installer son labo au cœur de la base, dans un des bassins où ces monstres d’acier sont remis à neuf entre deux patrouilles. Un site ultra-protégé, classé secret défense

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Un corps dont il ne reste quasiment que les os vient d'tre retrouvŽ dans un terrain vague... La victime Žtait-elle un homme ou une femme ? A quoi pouvait-elle bien ressembler ? A quand sa mort remonte-t-elle ? Et le meurtrier... a-t-il laissŽ quelques traces de son passage ? Cette semaine, Fred, Jamy et Sabine se glissent dans la peau des spŽcialistes de l'investigation criminelle. Ils nous expliquent comment les enquteurs franais parviennent ˆ exploiter les moindres indices pour retracer pas ˆ pas le scŽnario d'un crime.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: "Un petit pas pour l'homme, un bond de géant pour l'Humanité". Nous étions en 1969. Neil Armstrong venait de poser le pied sur la Lune… Aujourd'hui dans C'est pas Sorcier, Fred et Jamy remontent le temps et nous offrent une passionnante plongée dans cinquante ans d'histoire de conquête spatiale. Du premier satellite qu'on parvint à placer en orbite aux robots qui arpentent désormais la planète Mars, ils retracent les grandes étapes de cette fabuleuse aventure

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Longs comme 3 stades de foot, hauts comme un immeuble de trois étages et lourds de quelque 60 000 tonnes, les grands paquebots sont capables d'embarquer 5200 personnes à leur bord ! Comment ces titans des mers parviennent-ils à naviguer sans chavirer à la première intempérie ? Fred et Jamy embarquent pour les chantiers navals de Saint-Nazaire. Ils explorent pour nous les entrailles de ces mécanos géants et nous dévoilent quelques-uns leurs secrets de fabrication.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: A la recherche de nos ancêtres et de leur mode de vie, nous visitons la "maison" de Cro-magnon. En compagnie d'archéologues, Fred et Jamy nous font découvrir les gestes quotidiens des "premiers" hommes : la peinture, la chasse, la taille des silex, la confection des vêtements, la fabrication des armes. Nous apprenons les différentes étapes de l'évolution de l'homme et la manière de dater une découverte archéologique.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Nous partons à bord d'un sous-marin militaire pour les grandes profondeurs des océans. Nous découvrons les postes-clés et les équipements indispensables pour naviguer, ainsi que les lois physiques qui régissent la vie d'un sous-marin. Comment plonger et remonter ? Comment fabriquer de l'air pour respirer ? Comment naviguer dans le plus grand des silences pour ne pas être repéré ? Comment communiquer avec la surface et comment entendre les autres sous-marins ? Fred et Jamy répondent à toutes ces questions.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans le château de Castelnaud en Dordogne, nos deux animateurs se retrouvent plongés au coeur d'une bataille du Moyen-Age dans laquelle les belligérants utilisent de drôles de machines. Comment un château-fort est-il construit et avec quels outils ? Comment est organisée la défense du château ? Comment fonctionnent un trébuchet, une bricole, une arbalète, une bombarde et selon quel principe ? Comment travailler le fer pour fabriquer une épée ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: A l'intérieur d'un grand hôpital pour enfants, nous suivons le parcours d'un jeune admis pour une opération chirurgicale et découvrons l'ensemble des services et des examens qui permettent sa prise en charge. Comment peut-on voir à l'intérieur du corps ? Comment les rayons X et le scanner fonctionnent-ils ? Avoir de la température, qu'est-ce que ça veut dire ? Qu'est-ce qu'un groupe sanguin et de quoi le sang est-il composé ? Quel est le principe de l'anesthésie ? Que se passe-t-il pendant une opération ? Et une jambe cassée, comment la répare-t-on ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L’équipe de C’est pas sorcier consacre deux émissions à cette mystérieuse mécanique qu’est le cerveau. Le cerveau est le siège des émotions, de la pensée, du langage... C’est aussi un centre de commande extrêmement perfectionné qui nous permet d’agir et de ressentir. C’est cet aspect-là que nous expliquent Fred, Jamy et Sabine dans ce premier volet. A quoi correspondent la matière grise, le cortex, l’hypothalamus, le cervelet... ? Qu’est-ce qu’un neurone ? Pourquoi les neurones établissent-ils entre eux des milliards de connexions ? Comment les informations circulent-elles dans le cerveau ? Comment le cerveau se tient-il informé de ce qui se passe à l’extérieur de notre corps ? Quelles sont les zones du cortex qui sont les spécialistes de l’odorat, du goût, de la vue, du toucher... ? Comment notre cerveau orchestre-t-il nos mouvements ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Dans ce deuxième volet, nos sorciers nous expliquent comment on acquiert un langage, comment fonctionne notre mémoire, ce qu’est l’intelligence et si on peut la mesurer. Pour tout comprendre de la question, ils sont partis explorer leurs souvenirs d’enfance... Quelles sont les étapes du développement du cerveau du foetus ? Quel rôle l’environnement joue-t-il sur le développement de l’enfant ? Quelles sont les zones du cerveau qui sont activées quand on lit ou quand on parle ? Pourquoi possédons-nous une mémoire à court terme qui s’empresse de nous faire oublier certaines informations ? Comment nos souvenirs anciens sont-ils stockés ? Quels sont les processus qui font surgir ces souvenirs ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Mammouth des steppes, mammouth de Colomb ou mammouth laineux… A quoi les mammouths ressemblaient-ils ? Sur quelles parties de la planète pouvait-on les croiser ? Avec quels animaux cohabitaient-ils ? Changement climatique, maladie ou chasse intensive… Par quel mystère ont-ils finalement disparu ? Le clonage pourra-t-il un jour les faire revenir ? Fred, Jamy et Sabine dressent le portrait de ce pachyderme mythique, disparu il y a 4000 ans.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Les océans recouvrent 71% de notre planète. Cette immense étendue bleue abrite une biodiversité extraordinaire : plus de 170 000 espèces y ont été répertoriées. Et nous ne cessons d'en découvrir de nouvelles. A moins de pratiquer la plongée sous-marine, la meilleure manière de découvrir la richesse du milieu marin est de se rendre dans un grand aquarium. Cette semaine, C'est pas sorcier nous ouvre les portes de l'aquarium de La Rochelle.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy sont partis à la rencontre des baleines à bosse et des cachalots, dans leur aire de reproduction, les Caraïbes. Ils nous expliquent pourquoi les cétacés sont en danger et quelles solutions peuvent être proposées afin de les protéger. En 1960, 90% des individus avaient été exterminés, résultat de la chasse intensive à la baleine. Convoitées pour l'exploitation de leur viande, de leur graisse et de leur huile, les Baleines ont depuis longtemps été chassées par l'homme. Du Japon à l'Amérique, en passant par l'Europe, ces sympathiques cétacés ont été décimés avec les débuts de l'industrialisation, au 19 ème et 20 ème siècle. Après la seconde guerre mondiale, ce sont 50 000 cétacés qui sont tués par an dans le monde. Aujourd'hui protégées de la chasse commerciale par la commission baleinière internationale, les baleines restent cependant "menacées" ou "en danger d'extinction". Quotas de prises non respectés, réchauffement climatique, pollution chimique et, même, pollution sonore, sont de la partie! Devant le peu de répit que l'homme laisse aux cétacés, le rétablissement des stocks d'origine est largement compromis. Fred termine son périple dans un bateau de Whale Watching, activité touristique discutable, qui permet chaque année à des milliers de gens d'aller observer les baleines de près.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L'adolescence est l'âge de tous les bouleversements. Le corps se métamorphose à une allure folle. La silhouette devient celle d'un adulte. On se découvre une sexualité. Et le monde change. Les copains prennent toujours plus de place, tandis que les parents perdent un peu de leur aura... Fred et Jamy accompagnent un groupe d'adolescents pour un séjour au ski. Avec la complicité du pédopsychiatre Marcel Rufo, ils nous font découvrir les phénomènes à la fois physiologiques et psychologiques qui sont à l'origine de l'adolescence.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Numéro spécial de 52 minutes C’est pas sorcier embarque pour le Pérou et nous offre un numéro spécial de 52 minutes consacré à la cordillère des Andes et à l’extraordinaire civilisation qui y régnait avant l’arrivée des Espagnols : les Incas. Du célèbre Machu Picchu, niché au cœur d’une vallée stupéfiante, aux îles solitaires du lac Titicaca, en passant par la capitale historique de Cusco, Fred et Jamy nous invitent à explorer les trésors du Pérou. Nous découvrons avec eux comment des hommes et des femmes qui ne connaissaient ni la roue, ni l’écriture, ni le fer… sont parvenus à construire des cités hors des communes nichées à plus de 3000 mètres d’altitude. Les Andes, l'un des plus anciens foyers de civilisation du monde Avant de partir sur la piste des Incas, Fred et Jamy nous emmènent à la découverte des grandes civilisations qui les ont précédés. Chavin, Moche, Nazca, Paracas… c’est au cœur de la cordillère des Andes que tous ces peuples ont vu le jour. Les Incas, l'empire du Soleil Nos deux complices s'attaquent ensuite au plus grand et au plus riche de tous les empires d'Amérique du Sud : l'empire Inca. Cette civilisation qui a régné à peine plus d'un siècle s’est étendue sur un vaste territoire, qui allait du sud de la Colombie à l’Argentine et au Chili.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy partent à la découverte des mammifères géants qui peuplent les eaux de l'Archipel Antillais. République Dominicaine, Guadeloupe Baleines à bosse qui s'y réfugient pour mettre bas et élever leurs petits en toute sécurité, ou cachalots qui profitent des failles marines pour chasser dans les profondeurs... ils nous offrent une plongée mémorable avec ces titans magnifiques.Dans les eaux chaudes et abritées du récif corallien de Sylver bank, l'agitation règne. C'est ici que les baleines à bosse ont choisi de faire halte pour mettre au monde leurs petits et se reproduire. Entre parades de séduction et fragiles baleineaux, Fred est parti plonger au milieu de ces géants ailés...Nous le retrouvons ensuite au large de la côte sous le vent de la Guadeloupe. Là, il embarque avec des naturalistes passionnés qui observent de près des champions de la chasse en apnée : les cachalots.Pourquoi les baleines parcourent-elles des milliers de kilomètres à travers les océans de la planète ? Comment ces mammifères sont-ils passés de la terre à la mer ? Que signifient leurs chants magnifiques ? Pourquoi la pêche, la pollution et les changements climatiques rendent-ils les populations de cétacés si vulnérables ? Fred et Jamy sont partis en mer des Caraïbes pour rencontrer ces géants des mers. Ils sont allés observer les baleines qui élèvent leurs petits dans les eaux chaudes et calmes de la République Dominicaine. Et c'est au large de la Guadeloupe qu'ils ont accompagné une équipe de scientifiques passionnés pour découvrir les cachalots qui chassent dans les profondeurs marines.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: L'avantage d'une centrale nucléaire, c'est qu'elle ne produit pas de gaz à effet de serre. Un atout formidable pour lutter contre le changement climatique qui s'annonce... L'inconvénient d'une centrale nucléaire, c'est qu'elle produit des déchets. Des déchets contaminés, dont certains resteront radioactifs pendant des milliers, voire des millions d'années ! Que faire de nos déchets nucléaires ? C'est la question que Fred et Jamy se sont posée. Que se passe-t-il quand des particules radioactives sont inhalées ou ingérées ? De 30 ans à un milliard d'années... combien de temps faut-il pour qu'un déchet cesse d'être radioactif ? Que fait-on des déchets les plus radioactifs ? Pourquoi a-t-on choisi d'enterrer certains déchets dans les couches géologiques profondes ? Qu'adviendra-t-il de ces déchets dans 4000 ans ? Dans 200 000 ans ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Il existe en France dix-neuf centrales nucléaires qui produisent à elles seules 80% de notre électricité. Chacune de ces centrales est une gigantesque cocotte minute qui transforme la vapeur d'eau en électricité. A l'intérieur de ce système ? Des dizaines de tonnes d'uranium que l'on casse pour qu'il libère son énergie. Dans ce premier volet - et avant de s'attaquer à la question des déchets nucléaires - C'est pas sorcier fait le point sur la production de l'énergie nucléaire en France. Comment peut-on produire de l'électricité avec de la vapeur d'eau ? Pourquoi faut-il casser l'uranium pour qu'il libère son énergie ? Qu'est-ce que c'est une réaction en chaîne ? Si un accident grave se produisait à l'intérieur d'une centrale nucléaire française, que se passerait-il exactement ? Et selon quel plan les centrales nucléaires devraient-elles progressivement remplacées ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: D'où viennent les étoiles filantes ? C'est quoi exactement, une météorite ? Et les astéroïdes ? Et les comètes, avec leur queue qui s'étalent sur des dizaines de millions de kilomètres, d'où viennent-elle ? Sabine part à la chasse aux météorites. Nous découvrons avec elle le travail de fourmi qu'exige la recherche de ces cailloux célestes qui renferment un peu de notre histoire. Puis nous la retrouvons à l'Agence Spatiale Européenne pour découvrir le satellite Rosetta, qui, après un voyage spatial de presque 10 ans, devrait venir se placer sur l'orbite de la comète Wirtanen pour l'observer de près. Jamy nous explique comment les astéroïdes sont apparus, pourquoi les étoiles filantes arrivent jusqu'à nous, mais aussi de quoi sont constituées les comètes

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine sont dans les îles éoliennes, entre la Sicile et la péninsule italienne. Ce chapelet d'îles volcaniques, né de la rencontre chaotique des plaques africaine et européenne, abrite trois volcans encore en activité : Lipari, Vulcano et Stromboli, l'un des volcans les plus actifs au monde. Depuis ce petit paradis terrestre, ils nous offrent une découverte de l'extraordinaire diversité de l'activité volcanique. Pourquoi la plupart des volcans fleurissent-ils à la jonction des plaques de la croûte terrestre ? Comment naît un volcan ? Qu’est-ce qu’un point chaud ? Comment la lave remonte-t-elle des profondeurs du manteau terrestre ? Pourquoi parle-t-on de volcans effusifs et de volcans explosifs ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Le 6 août 1945, Little boy, la première bombe atomique lancée par les américains, détruit la ville d'Hiroshima, tuant 140 000 personnes. Le 9 août, Fatman, une bombe au plutonium, explose au-dessus de Nagasaki et tue 80000 personnes. Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous expliquent tout sur l'armement nucléaire et la politique de dissuasion d'aujourd'hui.

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred, Jamy et Sabine nous racontent l'histoire des premiers hommes qui vécurent sur notre planète. Ils sont à Tautavel, près de Perpignan, où en 1971, une équipe d'archéologues a découvert le crâne d'un homme vieux de 450 000 ans. Quand et comment les premiers hommes apparaissent-ils dans l'histoire de notre planète ? Pourquoi pense-t-on que le berceau de l'humanité se trouve en Afrique ? A quoi ressemble l'Homo habilis ? Comment vit-il ? Les Homo ergaster sont de grands voyageurs. Jusqu'où sont-ils allés ? Pourquoi en Europe Homo erectus s'est-il progressivement transformé en homme de Neandertal ? Comment Homo sapiens a-t-il remplacé Neandertal ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Bientôt les vacances, bientôt la plage. Fred et Jamy sont sur la plage de Lacanau et nous rappellent qu’il y a des risques et qu’il faut prendre quelques précautions. Que trouve-t-on dans les eaux de baignades ? Jamy nous expliquera qu’un contrôle très strict de l’eau est effectué pour détecter bactéries, virus et autres polluants et qu’il existe une classification de A à D de la propreté des plages. Le soleil, il faut aussi s’en méfier. Comment peut-on expliquer le bronzage ? Et que se passe-t-il quand on attrape un coup de soleil ? Jamy va tout nous expliquer sur les effets des rayons ultraviolets UVA et UVB sur notre peau et sur la nécessité d’appliquer des crèmes solaires et de porter des lunettes pour préserver notre « capital soleil ». Avant de rentrer dans l’eau, il faut aussi être prudent pour éviter l’hydrocution. Jamy nous expliquera que c’est un choc thermique violent qui est souvent fatal. Sur la plage de Lacanau, Fred suit plusieurs surfeurs avec sa planche de body surf. Les vagues y sont très hautes et très belles. Mais les vagues comment se forment-elles ? D’où viennent-elles ?

programme.title: C'est Pas Sorcier
programme.desc: Fred et Jamy scrutent l’univers à partir de l’Observatoire de Haute-Provence et nous parlent des étoiles, galaxies, constellations, supernovas et des nébuleuses. Nous pénétrerons dans la salle du grand téléscope réservé aux professionnels de l’astronomie. En compagnie d’astronomes amateurs, nous essaierons de trouver les constellations avec un téléscope et une carte du ciel. Jamy nous expliquera pourquoi on a l’impression que les étoiles se déplacent dans le ciel, et pourquoi on ne les voie que la nuit. Il nous dira ce qu’est la voie lactée, comment naît et meurt une étoile.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After three cruel events in part 1, the World record holder on the deadlift with 501 Kg, will fight for the crown and the title. You simply cant miss this most epic show, at in the World Trade Center in Dubai part 2.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Superhumans arrive in Limassol. Great strongmen from all over the world will compete in the Old Port of Limassol , for the title and championship points. More than ever important this stage, as we come so close to the World Finals in Turkey this year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: With 12 of the world's best athletes arriving in Cape Town, South Africa, all fighting for the crown and final ranking points ahead of the World Finals in Turkey. Rayno Nel still needs to qualify along with Brian Kichton also battling for a seat in the World Finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This episode contestants fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever. Twelve finalists from all over the world are in Turkey and will fight for the ultimate title: WORLD CHAMPION 2024.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Part 2 of the world final of the Strongman Champions League tour 2024 in Alanya, Turkey. With three Events down and amazing results. Who will be the new World champion?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 opens in Joensuu, Finland in freezing -5°C conditions. Athletes battle frame carry as first event on ice and snow. Brian Kichton sets early pace, but Kevin Hazeleger ultimately wins with 27.57s. Competitors from USA, Finland, Turkey and others struggle with cold and debut performances, setting the tone for a global season. Cold conditions define the opening stage.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 Stage 2 in Riga, Latvia opens by the Baltic Sea with 12 athletes competing in spring conditions. Events include truck pull, log lift, bag toss medley, loading race and Atlas Stones. Home favourite Aivars Smaukstelis returns in emotional final Latvian appearance aiming for his third SCL crown. The competition begins with a truck pull opener setting early times.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 heads to Zrenjanin, Serbia for Stage 3, where elite athletes compete in a packed city-centre showdown. With four debutants joining established names like Evans Nana and Aivars Smaukstelis, competitors face brutal tests including a 16,000kg truck pull as the season builds momentum.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League 2025 kicks off in Crema, Italy, for Stage 4 of the season, bringing a world-class lineup to Lombardy. Athletes face brutal tests including car deadlift, log lift medley, Hercules hold, and Atlas stones, as reigning champion Rayno Nel returns fresh from major victory to defend his crown.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Netherlands, for a high-stakes summer showdown. A world-class lineup, including Rayno Nel, Brian Kichton, and Evans Nana, battles in extreme 35°C heat across six brutal events such as truck pull, Viking press, and Atlas stones, as the fight for SCL glory intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League returns to Doetinchem, Holland, for Stage 5 as athletes resume Day 2 of competition in a tight battle for the SCL title. With only three events remaining, competitors face a brutal sandbag loading race and other heavy tests, as Kevin Hazeleger and Rayno Nel fight for the overall lead.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Strongman Champions League heads to Joensuu, Finland, for Stage 7 as athletes battle to be crowned the World’s Strongest Viking 2025. Twelve competitors face nine gruelling events in a high-stakes showdown, with top contenders like Brian Kichton, Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana fighting for crucial championship points.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Esposende, Portugal, for the World’s Strongest Latino contest. Twelve elite athletes battle through a truck pull, deadlift, log lift, bag toss and medley in front of a packed crowd. Early leader Juan Ferrer sets the pace, as Invernizzi and others fight for top honours.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Farnborough, England, for the 2025 World Championship Truck Pull at the British Motor Show. Top international athletes compete in this spectacular test of strength, pulling massive vehicles as crowds gather for a thrilling showcase of power and endurance.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: Stage 10 of the Strongman Champions League 2025 arrives in Gdańsk, Poland, where a world-class lineup competes in tough events including deadlift, log lift, and loading race. With top athletes like Aivars Smaukstelis and Adam Roszkowski in action, the battle intensifies as the season nears its climax.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League heads to Siófok, Hungary, by Lake Balaton for a crucial late-season showdown. Reigning champion Adam Roszkowski returns to defend his title against a stacked field, including Aivars Smaukstelis and Evans Nana. With World Finals approaching, the battle for points intensifies.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League makes its U.S. debut in Toledo, Ohio! In day 1 of 2, fourteen world-class athletes battle for the SCL USA title across four powerhouse events — including a Super Medley featuring a car push, Fingal’s Finger, and a stone-breaking challenge. Other highlights include the Front Hold with a whiskey barrel, a keg toss into water, and a gruelling 130,000 kg boat pull - capped off by an electrifying Guinness World Record attempt.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: It’s the final day of the Strongman Champions League’s first-ever U.S. event in Sandusky, Ohio. Athletes face a massive gas tanker truck pull, a unique shovel deadlift, and Atlas Stones weighing 120–200 kg - plus a thrilling Guinness World Record attempt. Who will claim the SCL USA crown?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League lands in Dubai for its penultimate stage before the World Finals. Elite athletes battle across gruelling events, including the dumbbell press, deadlift, and bag toss. With fierce competition and rankings on the line, every point counts in the race to qualify for South Africa.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League continues in Dubai for the final stage before the World Finals. Twelve elite athletes battle gruelling events near the Burj Khalifa, with Ramin Farajnejad leading after three rounds. With fierce competition and last chances to qualify, the stakes couldn’t be higher.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals begin in Uppington, South Africa, after a global season of elite competition. Top athletes gather for a dramatic showdown, led by reigning champion and hometown hero Rayno Nel, as they battle in extreme events for the ultimate strongman title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League 2025
programme.desc: The Strongman Champions League 2025 World Finals continue in Uppington, South Africa. With three wins already, hometown hero and World’s Strongest Man Rayno Nel leads the competition, backed by a passionate crowd. As athletes battle by the Orange River, the fight for the title and $50,000 intensifies.

programme.desc: The 10th stage of this year's competition in Strongman Champions League is held in the Romanian city of Sibiu where the 12 strongmen continue to compete for the title.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 11th stage is the SCL Log Lift World Championships in Lithuania. In this championship, each competitor must lift three different weights overhead. Zydrunas Savickas is the current world record holder in the Log Lift.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This next episode of the Strongman Champions League is hosted in Lithuania and sees us getting one step closer to the final.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The 13th stage of Strongman Champions League is in Maia, Portugal. The competition is at the “Powerexpo” – one of the best sport and fitness events in Portugal.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage is in Martinique and eight strongmen from all over the world will compete for the last chance to gather points before the world grand finals in December.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A special World championship under the newcomers and lightweights in the Strongman world. Some of them will step from this to the heavyweights divisions.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: After 15 outstanding competitions all over the world, finally we are here at the final competition of this year’s Strongman Champions League hosted in Turkey.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the land of Vikings - Norway - to the first stage of the SCL World Series 2016

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The second stage of the SCL heads to the FIBO convention, Cologne. The leading international trade show for fitness, wellness and health hosts.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: For the third stage of SCL world series 2016, the athletes compete in Kaunas for the SCL Log Lift World Championships.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stage four is an epic competition and a few surprises. With 14 strongmen from all over the world, one newcomer left quite an impression.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This year Lauri Nami joins the starting list, back after last year's injury in Romania

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The SCL train stopped in Zlatibor for the stage 6 of the MLO SCL. 11 compete for the title in the home country of legendary Ervin Katona.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Bulgaria hosts the next stage of the SCL. Current leader in the World Series is Matjaz Belsak, youngest competitor and strongest man of Slovenia.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The competitors battle it out in the special event, the Atlas Steel Stone. This stone is made completely from iron and cannot be touched with any support.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This stage sees the strongmen visit Vaasa, Finland. Residents here are familiar with the competition because some of the SCL icons are from their country.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: 38 athletes compete in the under 90kg and under 105kg SCL World Championships. From each weight class, the top 12 qualify for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A two day, seven event battle with lots of spectators.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Alex Moonen is leading. Part two of the competition in Romania showcases a new challenge - Hercules Hold.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this stage in Curacao no one wants to lose the chance to fight for one kilo gold in World grand finals in Dubai.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The last chance to qualify for the World Grand Finale. Zageris and Belsak fight for the better position for the finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We reach Dubai where we will crown the new champion for SCL 2016. This is part one of the world finals.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: In this last episode, the best athletes compete in Pole Push, Deadlift, Forward Hold and Loading.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: We are in beautiful Norway for the kick off of the 2017 MLO Strongman Champions League season. With partly cloudy weather and lots of snow, we have the perfect scenery for the athletes, who prepare for the first contest of the year.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: A definite highlight in this FIBO edition in Germany, Strongman Champions League introduced its new rules for a special team item. Graham Hicks tries here to set a New World Record on the biggest log in the world, currently held by Krzysztof Radzikowski. Boosted also by the presence of the acclaimed in the strongman circles names of Mark Felix and Danis Zageris.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The courtroom dynamics of the Casey Anthony trial are examined.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Exclusive interview with Windy Hall, the biological mother whose 5-year-old malnourished son, Jordan Bleimeyer, was locked in a closet by his father and stepmother.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In March 2014, authorities found severely malnourished 5-year-old Jordan Bleimeyer after he allegedly had been locked inside a small closet under the stairs of a Houston-area home. His father, Bradley, and stepmother, Tammi, were arrested and charged with felony child endangerment. In an exclusive interview, Tammi breaks her silence -- why does she say she had no idea what was happening to her stepson?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The siblings of 5-year-old Jordan Bleimeyer, who was held captive in a tiny cubbyhole under the stairs, starved and abused by his father and stepmother, reveal how they sneaked Jordan food and freed him from his closet prison, saving his life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman says her ex-boyfriend blocks her from their son.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is a mother too unfit to see her own child?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Desperate for help with their drug-addicted 21-year-old son, Doug and Debbie ask Dr. Phil to prepare them for an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: On March 2, 2012, 19-year-old Jacob “Jake” Limberios was fatally shot in the head in the presence of three friends. The coroner ruled his death a suicide -- but Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say it doesn’t add up. They claim there was no investigation into Jake’s death, no evidence collected and no autopsy performed before Jake's death was ruled a suicide -- and they refuse to believe their son would take his own life. Jake’s family say a lot of questions remain unanswered, including: Who fired the shot? Two witnesses, Brittany and Will, adamantly maintain that Jake accidentally shot himself, but Mike and Shannon say their son knew how to handle guns safely and that the evidence doesn’t support that conclusion. Mike takes Dr. Phil cameras to the scene of the shooting to demonstrate why he believes that Jake was shot by someone else in the room. And, Brittany and Will face Mike and Shannon on Dr. Phil’s stage in an attempt to clear the cloud of suspicion that they say still follows them as a result of Mike and Shannon’s allegations. When offered a chance to take a polygraph test, will they accept? Don’t miss this compelling two-part mystery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. The pandemic shutdown further exacerbated the mental challenges, and youth mental health is trending in the wrong direction across the country. Why is this happening? How do parents and schools play a role? Some experts believe young people were never taught how to fend for themselves because they were raised in a bubble by “concierge parents“ who protected them from learning about life and developing resiliency. Twenty-four-year-old Gracelyn says she describes her childhood just that way. She admits she was overprotected in some ways growing up, which she believes led to struggles with anxiety and depression for the past six years. What does she reveal for the first time? Also, parents of teens with mental health struggles talk about their frustrations. This is a life-saving episode you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation about the rise in mental health issues among young people continues. Dr. Phil speaks with 22-year-old Emma, who says she was a cheerleader and “picture-perfect American girl” who appeared happy on the outside but was secretly struggling with severe anxiety and depression, which led her to make a near-fatal decision that changed her life forever. Ross Szabo, the wellness director at Geffen Academy at UCLA, the CEO of the Human Power Project, and co-author with Melanie Hall of Behind Happy Faces: Taking Charge of Your Mental Health, says he has ideas to implement more mental health education in schools. And, Massachusetts's Congressman Seth Moulton shares his latest project: the new 9-8-8 National Suicide Prevention Lifeline. Americans experiencing a mental health crisis or who are concerned about the mental health of a loved one are now able to dial 9-8-8 and get rapid, free, trained and confidential help from a network of 200+ local crisis centers nationwide.

Tune in for expert tips, stunning scenery, and the thrill of fishing in Northern Ontario!

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: In the quarter finals, Belgian Moroccan Anis Bouzid (48-4, 37 KO) takes on kickboxing legend Errol Zimmerman (112-20-1, 45 KO), Serbian sensation Milos Cvjeticanin (17-5, 10 KO) meets number one French heavyweight Sofian Laidouni (42-5-1, 20 KO), monstrous Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (29-4-1, 16 KO) clashes with ‘The Soldier’ Nidal Bchiri (20-5-1, 5 KO), and ‘The Black Ghost’ Mory Kromah (35-3-1, 21 KO) collides with outspoken rival Michael ‘Timebomb’ Boapeah (23-5-1, 29 KO). programme.desc: A five-round heavyweight title eliminator between the number one ranked contender Levi Rigters (18-2, 8 KO) and ‘The Golden Wolf’ Bahram Rajabzadeh (69-3, 61 KO). The winner will face ‘The King of Kickboxing’ Rico Verhoeven (64-10, 21 KO) on December 7 in the main event of COLLISION 7. In the co-main event of the evening, Tariq ‘Cookie’ Osaro (25-4-1, 13 KO) clashes with Nico ‘Big Sexy’ Horta (23-9, 3 KO) in a monster heavyweight clash with big implication for the rankings. Croatian kickboxing legend Mladen Brestovac (55-14-1, 37 KO) will make his final walk to the ring in his hometown of Zagreb. ‘The Scorpion Sting’ will take on newcomer Karim Dian (16-13, 3 KO) to cap off an illustrious career. Top ten heavyweights Nordine Mahieddine (28-15, 13 KO) and Nikola Filipovic (11-2, 6 KO) will collide in what is a guaranteed barn burner between two prolific KO artist.

In the co-main event, Donovan Wisse (21-1, 10 KO) aims to defend his GLORY middleweight world championship for a fifth time when he welcomes the challenge of top German Sergej Braun (44-13, 27 KO).

programme.title: The Raven Project

programme.title: The Raven Project
programme.desc: The boys are on the Raven in Missouri trying to plant 50 acres of Big Tine food plots in 5 days before heading out west to kick off the hunting season.

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: Join Bryan Brown, Rigsby Stewart, and Chase Herndon along with Lee Ellis on our annual opening week hunt in Northern Nebraska. Big Bucks were spotted and a tag was punched on an unexpected buck on opening day!

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Deer and Deer Hunting
programme.desc: Contributor Josh Honeycutt breaks down the profound impact of hunting mentorship, exploring why it is equally vital to guide the next generation and to have a mentor of your own. The episode highlights the true reward of these bonds by showcasing a memorable hunt where Josh's guidance and mentorship make a massive, life-changing impact on a young hunter.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson's South African journey continues as he travels deeper into the rugged terrain of the Eastern Cape. In this episode, he is in pursuit of one of Africa’s most challenging and elusive plains game species, the Cape Bushbuck. Known for their ability to vanish into thick vegetation at the first sign of danger, hunting these "ghosts of the bush" requires extreme patience and precision. Join the crew as they navigate the dense brush and steep hillsides, battling shifting winds and thick cover to find a mature ram.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson on an epic hunting adventure in the stunning landscapes of New Zealand as he goes after Whitetail deer. On this hunt, Mark was unable to get his firearms import permit in time to take his Gunwerks rifle, so he'd have to borrow a trusty rifle from his guide, Shawn. Get ready for heart-pounding action, breathtaking scenery, and valuable tips and tricks from a seasoned hunter.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This week we are rolling along side the crew from Double T Outfitters. Management plays a huge role in every outfitters success every year. Bret and his team have a strong management plan in place and these guys had a blast with a group of out of state hunters.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Every year, hunters from across the country flock to various parts of Texas to extend their hunting season. This year, our friends from Struttinbuck did just the same. Matt and Clede make the long drive to Del Rio to hunt South Texas bucks right on the Mexico border.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting. Not only does he make incredible dishes with his former ‘masterchef’ contestant Alex which he serves to local children in need but he explains how hunting is never about “just the hunt” but about the camaraderie, friendship and memories made through the pursuit of the harvest.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: On this weeks episode of Hunting Land Man, Slade and his daughter Asa take on the turkey woods together for the first time. As this is Asa's first time turkey hunting some quick pre hunt preparations are in order. Slade also was able to sit down with a good friend and registered forester to talk fire and the benefits of fire in land management. The next day, Asa and Slade were able to connect with a thundering tom as Asa punched her first ever turkey tag!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade ends the saga with a deer he has watched for a few years, Pope. On a previous episode you saw Slade put in all of the work with feeder and food plot strategy to make the stars align. Make sure you watch that episode as well to see the behind the scenes work it took to bring Pope to 25 yards.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. Although the woods remained quiet, a tom soon snuck out of the woods and on the end of Bentley's barrel! After that Slade was able to help a client of his harvest his first turkey! And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team take a look into enhanced storage and utility options from Boat Outfitters like cooler slides, tackle storage and CoolerWebs . They also tackle applying Tuff-coat paint to the Aquasport project and showcase how easy it is to apply.

programme.title: Ship Shape TV
programme.desc: During this episode of Ship Shape TV Essentials the SSTV team follows the project of a detailed retrofitting of a Bertram upgrading from one motor to twin engines with the help of an Armstrong Bracket. The team then heads to Boatwrench Inc. to rebuild the carburetor for the Glastron project.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we take you to historic Saint Francisville, Louisiana. We closed on a couple of real estate properties in this area and want to show you why this area is so unique from a recreational standpoint. This place holds the “old south” feel that is ever so fleeting. We hunt on a property I sold to a client last year in Saint Francisville and manage to get a beautiful longbearded turkey on the ground. This episode is one you definitely don’t want to miss.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, we dive into how we are using our knowledge and experience to not only get some amazing hunting property, but to have other people pay for it. Sound too good to be true? - We also take you on some great hunts we’ve had on our journey flipping land and think back on some memories from the past and what the future is going to look like. - We hope you can learn a thing or two in this episode and encourage you to reach out with any questions you may have about this process.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade takes you on a ride through one of the coolest cities in the south, the historic Natchez, Mississippi. This is an area in which Slade sells a lot of hunting land and being only 40 minutes from where he grew up, Slade is very familiar with all there is to do in the area not only from a recreational standpoint but also for entertainment. Slade takes you through the showing process on a beautiful piece of property and bring it full circle at the closing. You’ll also watch a deer hunt with Slade in Natchez that was featured on Realtree Monster Bucks DVD. This is a jampacked episode with so much to learn and also enjoy. We know you’ll love it.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade gives you the grand tour of his home property. Slade’s dream was the same as many others, have a place where he can build a home, raise a family, and also have plenty of room to enjoy the outdoors and chase big rack bucks. Slade gives you a breakdown of how he took his raw tract of land and turned it into a beautiful homestead and outdoor paradise. If you are interested in how you can achieve your dream of raising a family on a dream property, this is the episode for you.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: WWII U.S. Navy veteran Bill Kruschel recounts a journey from humble beginnings in the midst of the Great Depression to his valuable service in the Navy, culminating in a lifelong commitment to the field of special education.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: An Honor No One Wants: A Gold Star Family is the immediate family member(s) of a fallen soldier who died while serving in a time of conflict. Kelli Campbell Goodnow honors the memory her husband…American hero Shawn Campbell.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: Vietnam war veteran Don Weber recounts his amazing journey through survivors guilt, PTSD and starting over.

programme.title: Operation Healing Heroes
programme.desc: U.S. Army veteran Carlos Powell tells of family sacrifice and fighting his post service “demons.”

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Denny McMahan on this episode at the legendary Thumbtack Ranch in South Texas. Denny was nominated by his wife for Bucks for the Brave program hosted by Trinity Oaks. After dedicating his life to service in the US Army and law enforcement, he now continues the mission by teaching at the police academy. Denny is a true hero in his community - someone who sacrifices his time, his well being, and his life in service to others, never asking for anything in return.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: In 2010, Amberly Snyder’s life changed forever when an accident left her paralyzed from the waist-down. Her comeback story not unlike something you’d see in a movie…in fact it inspired one. Disabled Outdoorsmen USA contacted TTHA and set up this hunt and we were fortunate enough to be able to capture just some of Amberly’s story and her harvest of a beautiful Axis buck at the G2 Ranch in the spring of 2022.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: Jennifer Brooks has spent her life answering the call to serve. From flying Blackhawk helicopters on multiple combat missions during two tours in Iraq to now serving as an Air Medical Pilot and first responder, her story is one of courage, sacrifice, and humility. In this episode of Storytellers, we join Jennifer in the field for a hunt that offers a rare moment to slow down, reflect, and honor a life dedicated to protecting others.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. The annual Father-Son hunt at FE Hill Outfitters has becoming a tradition for Heath and his son Gavin and in 2021, Gavin was able to take his largest buck to date, with his dad Heath behind the camera.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We join Blake Barnett alongside hunter Jimmy Reynolds as they take part in the 2nd Annual Pierce Dutton Memorial Hunt. This meaningful whitetail hunt is made possible by the great folks at Disabled Outdoorsmen. Jimmy settles in at the G2 Ranch in South Texas, where prime whitetail country and a shared passion for the outdoors set the stage for an unforgettable hunt.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We find ourselves fishing with Troy from Lonestar Beer. Not only is Troy a great friend he is also a big supporter of Hunters Extravaganza. We get to catch up in the offseason and spend a day on the water discussing future events and reflect on what all Texas has to offer.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: With over 20 years of service, retiring as a Senior Chief Machinery Technician, Steven served abord multiple Coast Guard cutters, led critical missions, protected our nation's leaders, and earned the Coast Guard Achievement Medal for his outstanding service. Beyond the uniform, Steven has has spent decades giving back - coaching youth sports, mentoring young athletes, and living the values of service, leadership, and integrity. Steven's dedication didn't end with retirement - and neither does our gratitude. We were honored to have Steven at Thumbtack Ranch and are even more grateful for his service.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: This is the story of how FE Hill ranch got it's start. From its inception, FE Hill has created opportunities for people to experience the outdoors and create memories. For us, it has created a tradition of Fathers and Sons hunting together.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson set off to hunt the American Alligator in eastern Texas. A species that was placed on the endangered species list in the 1960s, their populations are now thriving. Kyle and Jeff have agreed to help remove some problem gators off private land owned by their friend Troy, but things get rowdy when Kyle loses a bet and has to swim with the very gators he is hunting.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to Alaska to target sockeye salmon. The beautiful color of these harvested fillets will blow your mind.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Maryland to bow-fish for an invasive, toothy fish called the snakehead. They learn how this fish, a native of Asia, made its way to the United States. They also learn from the locals, despite its appearance, it is one tasty fish.

programme.desc: It happens, especially once the rut rolls around. A Monster Buck named drops that Tyler Jordan had been hunting all season wonders over to the neighbors and is shot by hunter Wesley Tyus. Check out the story of Drops and how Tyler was able to be there for the recovery of this once in a lifetime buck.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: The Road Trips crew has been getting after it during the rut in Georgia. Tyler Jordan kills a giant buck named "Crabby" while Jackie Bushman AKA Buckmaster was in camp with us!

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Bryan Brown and Michael Pitts have an epic week of bowhunting in Georgia during the rut! Did EHD cause a foot injury on the giant 10 point that Pitts was hunting?

programme.title: Realtree Road Trips
programme.desc: On his third trip of the season to Kansas, Tyler Jordan finally connects on a big flyer buck with his Hoyt RX-10 in hand. Everything comes together in a heart-pounding moment that bow hunters dream about.

programme.title: Realtree Roadtrips
programme.desc: Michael Pitts and the crew head out to Honeybrake Lodge in Louisiana for some big buck deer hunting action! Honeybrake is known as a top rated spot for duck hunting. The WRP management program has helped Honeybrake become one of the best spots for big bucks for the Road Trips crew late in the hunting season!

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Building a new bison herd on the island of Sitkaladak, the indigenous Alutiiq community of Old Harbour take ownership of their food security and subsistence way of life.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the remote Turkish mountains, host Dan Cabela looks at how regulated hunting of ibex has helped protect large areas for wildlife, and funds local conservation initiatives.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his son, Logan visit the beautiful country of New Zealand. From visiting Vineyards and sampling wine, to helicopter hunts for Himalayan Tahr, this episode is everything that is a hunters dream. As well as harvesting the wild game New Zealand has to offer Andy also learns about the importance of the conservation efforts that hunting has in this country from locals in which he spends time with.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. Whilst traversing steep mountains in the company of Kodiak brown bears and taking on cold Alaskan waters, Andy presents useful information for fellow outdoor enthusiasts all whilst building friendships with the great people of Kodiak Big Timber Lodge.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Join Rush and his good friend Anthony Solmo for an epic day of fishing in the stunning waters of Key West, Florida! Gliding quietly through the shallows, they target a variety of species—including hard-pulling Tarpon and explosive topwater Jacks—leaving Rush thinking, “A guy could get used to this kind of fishing!”

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Jacksonville's C & O's colorful and quirky car culture.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: C & O: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane: North America's greatest car show

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Amelia Island's own Caffeine & Octane car show,: Featuring $2,000 Wrek Racing Truck, David Patterson's favorite C&O cars, a plastic Citroen Mehari, and much more.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The Concours d'Elegance from Amelia Island: Featuring bomb-proof Conquest Knight XV, '69 Camaro Hagerty Fixer-Upper, and car-enthusiast John Oates.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: State-of-the-art engineering and passion projects take center stage on this edition of Caffeine & Octane. The revolutionary Delta Wing Racer turns on hot lap after hot lap at Road Atlanta, and driver Katherine Legge offers insight on how “less is more” when it comes to power to weight ratios; the dark world of a graffiti artist paints a picture of a car called Vengeance while the hosts share the eclectic hybrids of machines that make it to Caffeine and Octane with Vengance’s creator Totem.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Rickey and Bryan race outside of their comfort zones, each competing to find the raddest car collection. Rickey hangs out with classic racer, Ron Green, who shows him the ropes in the ultra light '83 Ralt RT5. Bryan visits a collection of 120 racing motorcycle owned by mechanic and racer Mike McConville. Mike takes Bryan motorcross racing in his backyard after showing off his high horsepowered car collection. Caffeine and Octane alongside Ron Green visit Atlanta's first Concours d'elegance to look at classic cars that have been perfectly maintained for decades.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Wayne Phears’ Jaguar E-Type was nothing more than a diamond in the rough before the mineral rights attorney took on the basket case. Caffeine & Octane brings viewers the story of how Phears’, through relentless research and determination, restored and reunited the #10 Jag that Enzo Ferrari called “the most beautiful car ever made”; Atlanta Wraps shows how wrapping Corvettes and Lamborghinis can color a car fast. Caffeine and Exotics is featured again to show off the coolest wraps Atlanta can supply.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Twenty-five years of hand building record-setting race cars is no easy task. But don’t tell that to Don Panoz who takes on Porsches and Ferraris with his laid back personality and a full-production facility that makes improvised versions of Americas V-8’s; Caffeine & Octane gets an exclusive look at an elusive man’s life long pursuit of everything Chevrolet.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane goes old school with Psycho Deville singer and pin striper Walt Richards. Richards has less than a week to hand paint his signature flames on a way cool ’50 Mercury. An introduction to Retrofit Lighting’s trickle down technology - from cars to motorcycles - that will revolutionize how bikes will see and be seen.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Caffeine & Octane is known for having something for everyone. That reputation is tested when over 100 VW’s, on the lunatic fringe of automotive, rattled into an event. The annual VW Invasion has swarmed C&O, bringing with it Bugs, Beetles, Buses and more by a very dedicated VW fan base.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Season 1 finishes on a high note when rapper, radio, and ATL TV personality Darian “Big Tigger” Morgan invites Caffeine & Octane into his home. Cameras look past his collection of 500 Michael Jordan shoes to focus their lenses on a one-off motorcycle the 6 – time NBA Champion gave to Tigger as a gift; A second to none, muscle car collection by one of the founders of Monster Energy gets toured by one of our hosts.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Vintage Testarossas and Quatra Valve Ferraris don’t just show up on a dealer’s floor, they’re hunted! Adam Merlin, exotic car expert, has spent a lifetime searching for the cars that defined his youth, but nothing is assumed or given in his high stakes game of Risk; A muscle car fiend shows off his private collection to host Skip Smith.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the major league of North American car shows. Former Atlanta Brave, World Series star, and 10-Time Gold Glove winner Andruw Jones acknowledged the stardom and showed up to show off his 6 wheeled Super Jeep. The state of the art creation took years in planning and execution, but Jones chooses one great event for its debut.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The natural landscape of Jekyll Island, GA makes for a great backdrop to showcase the country’s greatest cars. But the ocean air and remoteness of this GA barrier island is no place to leave a painstakingly rebuilt ‘59 Imperial Speedster. Host Skip Smith makes it his mission to locate the talented builder behind this island mystery. Guest host Totem joins Bryan Fuller in the C&O lots to pick out his favorites.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Imagination, ingenuity, and heartache join friends who set out with a simple goal of transforming a ‘35 Plymouth into a running taxi cab. Provenance and passion take center stage as families and friends strive for best in show. Host Rickey Gadson checks out perfect replicas of the original Shelby Cobras and takes Skip and Bryan on ‘borrowed’ taxi ride.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: Call the Peach State Challengers a “car club” and you will quickly be corrected. The defenders of everything Dodge are “family” and they make no excuses for their loyalty to brand and brother. Spend a day at the track with these Challengers and find out what their version of the family photo looks like.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how super clean automotive upholstery, as well as the proper chemicals and detailing tools for deep cleaning vinyl and rubber surfaces.

programme.title: Rutter's Detailin Garage
programme.desc: Nick Rutter provides valuable tips and techniques for how to polish automotive glass as well as water spot removal and selecting the right polisher for the detailing job.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys have Federated’s 1990 454SS Project Truck in house and they’re doing a ton of work to it. From brakes and shocks to chassis work, this truck needs some love.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys tackle a steering issue in this supped up Jeep by replacing the worn-out power steering gear and installing a new power steering cooler. They toss in a few extras for the owner as well.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: With a toddler on the way, Kevin and Willie help get their friend’s police edition Chevy Impala family ready by tackling various maintenance issues and doing an upgrade or two.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: The guys help a 2009 Challenger owner add a little more get up and go to her car. Willie also sets up a trade deal with a ’70 Cuda owner to help get his car a little closer to restoration time.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: We’ve got a bright yellow C7 in the shop today and Kevin and Willie are installing new specialized long tube headers, exhaust and other extras to make this already robust platform even more powerful.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Fuller dreams of a life in Surf City, California and finds a garage of Dream Cars along the way.

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Sam goes inside the paint lab with Dupli-Color to find out what it takes to create a new kind of paint from start to finish

programme.title: Two Guys Garage
programme.desc: Find out what goes into the electrical wiring on a new age Super Car….not as much as you might think.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The 1970 Hemi Charger project is completed in the season finale.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: The Graveyard Ghouls return with the final assembly of the legendary General Lee which so happens to also be the official screen-used, record holding, freeway jump-car from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark isolates himself in the machine-shop and begins the assembly of the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger previously owned by a former cast member.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a delivery day at Graveyard Carz! We jump back and show you every moment in the restoration of our legendary, screen-used, record holding, General Lee from the 2005 Dukes of Hazzard film. It all builds to a reveal the Duke Boys would be proud of.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With all the distractions out of the way, Mark returns to the machine-ship to finish the 440 4BBL for the 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger while master-assembler Dave begins working on the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With Mark out of the shop looking at a potential new location for a Mopar car-dealership, the Graveyard Ghouls begin the drivetrain assembly’s for a 1970 Lime Light Tribute Superbird and our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: Mark the the Graveyard Ghouls race against the clock to finish up some last-minute tasks on their various Mopar restorations before traveling north to judge Little Creek Casino’s epic car show.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s another reveal day! Mark and Allysa install the graphics on the ’71 Plumb Crazy Challenger and the 1970 Lemon-Twist Roadrunner is finished and readied to be delivered to it’s owner. And Mark proposes - what he thinks is - a “brilliant” idea to the producers of the show.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: With our 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger nearing completion, works shifts to our 1970 Tribute Superbird while Mark and Cousin Dougie build out a 340 engine and Will assists with metal work with George to help him stay on schedule.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz
programme.desc: It’s a special day at Graveyard Carz. The 1970 Plum Crazy Challenger that has been part of our show since its inception is finally finished and ready to be shipped to it’s new owner. But before they do that, they take it to the coast to show it off at Chinook Winds Casino Resort Car Show!

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Nancy se retira furiosa de la junta de condominio, Pedro logra que Carlos Enrique se quede hablando con Lázara en lugar de ir detrás de su mujer. Patricia deja de estudiar y se va de la casa, harta de las burlas de Carlitos. Al pasar por delante de Pedrote este la intercepta para flirtear con ella y darle celos a Purita. Nancy los ve juntos y se indigna más aún. Cristóbal reserva el salón del condominio para casarse con Ana, ante los ojos de Guillermo. Nancy se queja con Carlitos de lo sucedido en la junta con su padre, pero a Carlitos sólo le interesa enterarse de que Purita quedó sola. Pedro logra que Cristóbal ponga de padrino de bodas al mismísimo Guillermo, generando incomodidad entre él y Ana.

programme.title: Episodio 108
programme.desc: Armando bota definitivamente a Finita de su oficina y de su vida. Por más que ella quiso explicarle | el no aceptó ninguna explicación y la sacó. Briggite anda perdida como siempre. No sabe lo que está haciendo caminando por un pasillo del centro comercial. Pero se encuentra con Yubiri y aprovecha para decirle que regrese a la agencia. Fabián sigue con el ratón. Llega Palma el Productor para darle una gran noticia a Wilker y es que consiguió una presentación en Sábado Sensacional.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Agustín confronta a Gabriel en la calle para dejarle claro que no se vuelva a meter con su mujer. Magdalena descubre en el baño de la casa de Sofía perfume y otras cosas de hombre, por lo que a ella no le queda más remedio que confesar que tiene novio. Magdalena se extraña, ya que siendo su amiga no le contó antes, y Sofía dice que no le contó antes porque el hombre es casado. Luego, Magdalena le cuenta esto a Agustín, y cuando Agustín se encuentra con Sofía se enoja con ella por no poder haber inventado otra excusa.
